title: Nashville Riverfront
description:
"Hunt House Dockside" on the Banks of the Cumberland River in Nashville, the perfect place to gather Family and Friends for your Nashville Vacation or a quick weekend getaway.  Our Riverfront Home is Cozy and comfortable with covered porches and decks-all the comforts of home. Conveniently located just minutes from Downtown Nashville and BNA. The Grand Ole Opry and Opry Mills all in walking distance.

The space
Our back yard is a refuge for all. Hot Tub and Boat Dock with water access for Kayaks, and Fishing.

Guest access
The Main House is all yours with Front and Back Deck access as well as back yard and River- Dock access. Our Home has 3 Levels with 2 Private Living spaces. Our guest space is the Main House which includes 1st floor, 2nd floor and lower level. Our Living Quarters and private entrance when in town is the side door at the opposite end of the Front Porch-completely separate.

Other things to note
Our Home has 3 Levels with 2 Private Living spaces: 
1. Our Guest space is the Main House, entry through the Front Door (stained glass). This includes 1st floor and 2nd floor and lower level.
2. Our Living Quarters has a private entrance off the far side of the Front Porch (side door).
3. We live full-time on the property unless we are away traveling.  We are available to our guests 24/7.  Our hope is you will feel the same comforts of our Home as we do. It is a blessing to share our home!
